blocked_subpart.part: B/Escape key-press -> actual close in Studio
blocked_subpart.reason: Roblox Studio MCP input cannot produce a ContextActionService Begin event; UserInputService.InputBegan observes synthetic keys but a BindActionAtPriority probe receives only UserInputState.Cancel, and VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent is unavailable from the MCP thread (lacking capability RobloxScript). Needs a real keyboard/gamepad manual Studio session.

studio.probe: GuiService.SelectedObject read live after each Visible toggle (50ms settle)

defect_found_and_fixed: First policy removed a screen from the registry on close, so a reopened screen had no default. Split permanent _byId registry from active _stack; locked by navigation_spec close->reopen regression (mutation-checked).
